blocks.content: A rock is a consolidated mixture of one or more minerals. Some rocks are composed of a single mineral (for example, marble made primarily of calcite), while others contain several minerals such as granite.
A rock is a consolidated mixture of one or more minerals.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: A rock is a consolidated mixture of one or more minerals.
Rocks can be either hard or soft and lack a definite chemical composition.
Some rocks contain a single mineral (like marble made of calcite), while others contain multiple minerals (like granite).
The Earth's crust is made almost entirely of rocks formed through natural geological processes.

blocks.content: • Rocks may be hard or soft.
• They do not have a definite chemical composition.

items: Remember for assertion-reason questions: Rocks do NOT have a definite chemical composition.
Calcite is the primary single mineral that constitutes marble.
The entire Earth's crust is composed almost completely of naturally formed geological rocks.

blocks.content: • They form through natural geological processes.
• The Earth's crust is made almost entirely of rocks.
